timing_and_classification.extension_timing: post-primary-period-descriptive/unadjusted-results and post-some-historical-results; pre-adjusted-primary-period matrix and estimation

historical.restrictions: Use only outcomes/covariates marked comparable by the historical comparability matrix. Never use or impute hourly LOS. Never pool automatically with 2010-2024.

periods.ami_greenwood: Remains a separate ED-only extension and is not pooled into the directional dyad families.

measurement_definitions.physician_race: Five-class Bayesian full-name wru v2.0.0 dictionary proxy without residential geography; algorithm-inferred, probabilistic, not self-reported and not BISG.
measurement_definitions.physician_race_primary_directional_repre: Probability-weighted posterior-mixture factorial model plus 20 physician-level multiple imputations drawn once per NPI and held fixed across that physician's visits.
physician_race_sensitivities: hard thresholds t70, t80, and t90
wru 2020 national population prior probability model
physician-level multiple imputation under alternative prior

patient_race_ethnicity_mapping.Hispanic: patient_ethnicity_category == 'Hispanic or Latino', regardless of recorded race
patient_race_ethnicity_mapping.White: patient_ethnicity_category == 'Not Hispanic or Latino' AND patient_race_category == 'White'
patient_race_ethnicity_mapping.Black: patient_ethnicity_category == 'Not Hispanic or Latino' AND patient_race_category == 'Black or African American'
patient_race_ethnicity_mapping.Asian: patient_ethnicity_category == 'Not Hispanic or Latino' AND patient_race_category == 'Asian'
patient_race_ethnicity_mapping.Other/multiracial: patient_ethnicity_category == 'Not Hispanic or Latino' AND patient_race_category IN ('American Indian or Alaska Native', 'Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander', 'Other')
patient_race_ethnicity_mapping.excluded: Unknown patient ethnicity; Unknown patient race; or any category that cannot be assigned without overriding the recorded fields

measurement_definitions.physician_gender: Recorded NPPES/CMS binary administrative category only for primary directional analyses; conflicts retained and flagged. SSA-inferred gender is sensitivity-only.
measurement_definitions.patient_sex: Recorded administrative Female/Male category; not gender identity. Unknown is retained in QA but ineligible for the binary directional model.

outcome_families.outcome_sample_rule: Each outcome uses its complete eligible outcome-specific sample. No outcome is imputed. Primary-period hourly LOS and reported real charges retain their frozen definitions.

model_sequence.description: Unadjusted saturated directional cell means and frozen linear contrasts on each outcome-specific eligible sample.
model_sequence.inference: Two-way CRV1 by attending NPI and facility when support permits; raw cell summaries are always retained.

model_sequence.description: Joint factorial linear model or linear probability model with standardized adjusted cell predictions and marginal linear contrasts.
covariates: log physician-quarter ED volume and missing flag
recorded patient sex in non-intersectional race models
compatible recorded patient race/ethnicity in gender models
model_sequence.inference: Two-way physician/facility CRV1; facility wild-score bootstrap sensitivity for frozen primary-outcome directional contrasts selected before fitting.

model_sequence.description: Within-physician sensitivity with physician, facility-by-year-quarter, and principal-clinical-category fixed effects. Time-invariant physician-group main effects are absorbed; report only identified within-physician patient simple effects and interaction differences.

primary_2010_2024.limited_support_flag: visits/effective visits < 5000 OR physicians/effective physicians < 50 OR facilities < 30

historical_2005_2008.limited_support_flag: visits/effective visits < 1000 OR physicians/effective physicians < 30 OR facilities < 20

support_and_estimability.contrast_rule: Every nonzero-weight cell must meet its period threshold; the contrast vector must be identified, its variance finite and nonnegative, and both clustering dimensions must meet the threshold. Otherwise mark NON_ESTIMABLE and retain the cell.
support_and_estimability.sparse_group_rule: Never merge a sparse race, ethnicity, sex, or gender cell. Report counts and mark LIMITED_SUPPORT or NON_ESTIMABLE.

multiplicity.confirmatory_family_unchanged: The original confirmatory family remains exactly the two frozen Black/White M2 interaction contrasts for outcome-specific LOS and reported real-charge samples, with Holm adjustment. No new directional contrast is added to or relabelled as confirmatory.

directional_families.members: 6 planned contrasts x 2 frozen primary outcomes
directional_families.tier: secondary extension except originally frozen four-cell interaction remains originally prespecified

directional_families.members: 68 planned contrasts x 2 frozen primary outcomes
directional_families.tier: secondary extension except originally frozen Black/White four-cell interaction remains originally prespecified

directional_families.members: 359 planned contrasts x 2 frozen primary outcomes

multiplicity.reporting: Every result row retains raw p-value, BH q-value, 95% confidence interval, family ID, tier, outcome sample, and estimability status. No finding is selected by q-value.

required_tables_per_family: standardized adjusted predictions or estimable marginal effects
visits/effective visits by cell and outcome
physicians/effective physicians by cell and outcome

analysis_script_audit.assessment: Contains primary-period descriptive and unadjusted binary Black/White race and binary sex/gender four-cell summaries. These predate this extension and are preserved.

Builds validated binary Black/White race and binary sex/gender matrices, including Black-probability sensitivities and a 16-cell binary intersectional design. It does not contain the requested five-class directional or 100-cell expanded intersectional design.
Implements the frozen HDFE/CRV1 estimation engine and selected covariance blocks. It can be reused, but new target matrices and contrast extraction are required.
Protects the original two-outcome Holm confirmatory family. New secondary/exploratory directional BH families must be added without changing that family.
Historical race analysis is binary Black/White and remains a separate sensitivity. Expanded historical directional analyses require separate compatible-variable matrices.
Historical binary sex/gender analysis is separate and reusable for the four gender cells.
Implements Black/White probability and threshold sensitivity logic only; it does not satisfy the five-class directional request.

Implements an exploratory binary-race 16-cell descriptive table and a single four-way coefficient. It does not provide the requested 100 directional cells, adjusted predictions, planned contrasts, or complete cell estimability diagnostics.
Implements physician-level multiple imputation for the existing binary race contrast. Its NPI-level draw and Rubin-pooling principles should be reused for five-class directional models.
Existing independent primary audit is preserved; the extension requires an additional fail-closed independent auditor.
Existing historical audit is preserved; any new historical directional result requires a separate extension binding.

preexisting_results_inventory.interpretation: Inventory and hashes only. The freeze script did not parse a coefficient, confidence interval, or p-value.

language_rule: Use association language only. Do not label any directional estimate an impact, causal effect, discrimination, concordance mechanism, or proof of clinician behavior.
fail_closed_rule: A matrix or result is invalid unless it reproduces the exact extension-manifest hash and every provider, cohort, measurement gate, source-registry, partition, and input-matrix hash stored here. Independent validation is required before viewing or reporting estimates.
